topic: Adjusting frequency calculation for Action AI
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on calculating the correct frequency formula for Action AI (8006), specifically ensuring consistency between staging and production environments. Initially, a general Brazilian formula was provided. However, it was determined that a specific coefficient for Rio de Janeiro needed to be applied, similar to how JCDecaux Brazil (7885) handles its locations.

After implementing the necessary adjustment, discrepancies were observed in unique user counts between Action AI and JCDecaux Brazil for comparable traffic. The required Rio de Janeiro coefficient was identified and applied, resolving the variance. The fix was successfully implemented on staging and subsequently deployed to production.
decisions: The frequency calculation formula for Action AI (8006) must incorporate a specific coefficient for Rio de Janeiro.
The corrected frequency calculation has been fixed and deployed to both staging and production environments.
